tools.name: list_tariffs
tools.description: The time-of-use and standard tariffs from Octopus, EDF and E.ON Next that the `tariff` parameter accepts – or, with `direction=export`, their export tariffs (for get_prices and `export`), each saying which homes can have it.

tools.name: get_prices
tools.description: Half-hourly prices for a region from midnight today. On Agile (the default) and Agile Outgoing, each is published by Octopus or estimated by Renewably (flagged `estimate`); other tariffs show only their supplier's published prices. An export tariff's are what it pays for export (and take no panels).

tools.name: find_cheapest_window
tools.description: The cheapest (or lowest-carbon) run of `duration_hours` starting from the next half hour and finishing by the next `finish_by` – when to set a washing machine or dishwasher's delay timer.

tools.name: plan_ev_charging
tools.description: The cheapest or greenest half hours to charge an electric car by a ready-by time up to four days ahead.
